verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's core workflow includes adding many documents at once (batch indexing) and its MCP server lets an AI-native user add documents and run searches via natural language (meilisearch-docs-13/17, meilisearch-probe-rt-3), and community reports confirm large batch imports (million-document loads, 80M-document indexes) working via the API (meilisearch-comm-15, meilisearch-comm-16, meilisearch-comm-18). However, community evidence also flags indexing falling behind under heavy write/bulk load in production (meilisearch-comm-4) and unpredictable resource usage during bulk ingestion (meilisearch-comm-3), and there is no explicit documentation of bulk update/delete operations. Missing for 10: explicit docs on batch update/delete endpoints, and stronger evidence that bulk indexing scales reliably without the reported slowdowns.
